svg.title: Molecule of the day: Paracetamol
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Paracetamol while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 0.39.
svg.text: MW 151.2 · cLogP 1.35 · TPSA 49.3 · HBD 2 · HBA 2 · RotB 1
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
